shots.summary: Warm study room — Milo lifts a steaming ceramic mug while Nora reads across the oak table.

subtitles.text: Right now, you feel the chair beneath you, or the mug in your hand.

shots.summary: Closer on Milo holding the mug as the lifetime touch counter drops cleanly to zero.

subtitles.text: Except according to physics, you have never actually touched anything in your entire life.

shots.summary: Nora leans forward skeptically and pokes the oak tabletop three times.

subtitles.speaker: Nora
subtitles.text: Hold on. I am literally poking this table right now.

shots.summary: Ten-million-times zoom from Nora's fingertip into the glowing sub-nanometer gap above wood atoms.

subtitles.text: Zoom in ten million times, and your fingertip stops hovering a fraction of a nanometer above the wood.

shots.summary: Blueprint schematic of an atom wrapped in pulsing negatively charged electron shells.

subtitles.text: Every atom is wrapped in negatively charged electrons.

shots.summary: Two electron clouds press together and repel violently like invisible magnets as the force meter spikes.

subtitles.text: Push yours toward the table, and those clouds repel each other like invisible magnets.

shots.summary: Bright park bench — Nora celebrates levitating 0.2 nm above the bench as Milo high-fives her with a tiny spark.

subtitles.speaker: Nora
subtitles.text: So technically, I am levitating right now. Honestly, pretty impressive.

shots.summary: Forcefield indents skin and fires golden sensory nerve impulses up Milo's arm to his awe-struck face.

subtitles.text: What your nerves call solid is really that electromagnetic forcefield pressing your skin back before a single atom ever collides.

shots.summary: High-contrast collider diagram forces two nuclei to actually touch — triggering a golden nuclear fusion wave.

subtitles.text: Which is very good news, because forcing two atomic nuclei to actually touch is called nuclear fusion.

shots.summary: Close-up on Nora slowly pulling her hand back from the console in polite relief.

subtitles.speaker: Nora
subtitles.text: Okay, hovering is great. Suddenly a huge fan of the gap.

shots.summary: Scenic twilight overlook balcony — Milo and Nora clink warm mugs and shake hands across the glowing microscopic bridge.

subtitles.text: Yet across that tiny gulf, those invisible forces still carry warmth, weight, and every handshake you have ever felt.

shots.summary: Serene twilight horizon hold over the valley lights as the closing thought settles.

subtitles.text: Close enough to feel everything, without ever colliding.
